capabilities: Upload all images referenced in the current note to Aliyun OSS
Compress JPEG/WebP images via Canvas and PNG via UPNG.js before upload
Rewrite local image links to public OSS or custom-domain URLs in place
Manage and selectively upload images from a sidebar panel with status badges
Deduplicate uploads using SHA-256 content hashes and headObject checks
extras: Credentials are stored in plaintext in .obsidian/plugins/notepic-oss/data.json; the README warns to gitignore that file and use a restricted RAM subaccount. Bucket CORS must be configured for app://obsidian.md. A companion CLI exists for batch/CI use.
problem: Obsidian stores note images as local vault files, and there is no built-in way to push them to cloud object storage and convert references to public URLs.

relations.evidence: 上传到阿里云 OSS，并把链接原地替换为公网 URL
PNG 使用 UPNG.js；GIF / SVG / 动画图保持原样

requires.name: Aliyun RAM subaccount with OSS AccessKey ID and Secret

summary: Image uploader that compresses and uploads images referenced in the current note to Aliyun OSS, then rewrites the links in place.
